attr.title: I Love Katamari
attr.desc: I Love Katamari running its original ARMv5 Android engine directly on Linux through a bionic/JNI compatibility loader.
attr.inst: Supply your own I Love Katamari (English) Android APK named MMkatamari-englishhack.apk. Put it in ports/katamari/; the first launch extracts and validates it automatically. No game data is included.
